rules.verification: Derive required checks from the ticket and architecture, then verify the exact pull-request head and required CI.
rules.rollback: Return the ticket to In Progress with the missing check or uncovered behavior.

rules.verification: Record changed paths, relevant checks, cleanup, exact head SHA and CI links without committing test outputs.
rules.rollback: Keep the ticket In Progress, fix or rerun the affected check, and update the concise summary.

rules.owner: Builder or integrator running browser evidence
rules.timing: Before starting any production Next.js server
rules.verification: Record build output, unique port, process identity, readiness and cleanup; enforce one server per build output.
rules.rollback: Stop the recorded process, discard only its isolated output and rerun serially.

rules.timing: Before migration, seed, rollback or concurrency verification
rules.verification: Use a ticket/run-named disposable database resource and prove readiness, assertions and cleanup without shared Compose mutation.
rules.rollback: Remove only the disposable named resources; leave shared Compose and its volumes untouched.

rules.timing: After slice assembly and before combined review
rules.verification: Run the fixed-allowlist cleanup and declared Node 24/pnpm sequence with Turbo forced uncached.
rules.rollback: Reject the integration, restore the independently approved slice set and repeat from a fresh worktree.

rules.timing: Immediately after API generation in clean order
rules.verification: Snapshot the accepted client, generate twice, require both files and prove client baseline plus second-pass byte stability.
rules.rollback: Restore the pre-run client/OpenAPI state, return drift to the API-owning ticket and never hand-edit generated output.

rules.timing: Before and during combined closure review
rules.verification: Recompute changed paths, dependency/lock deltas and intentional runtime-binary hashes; reject retained test outputs.
rules.rollback: Reject the patch, remove unrequested outputs and rebuild the concise summary without silently dropping another slice.

rules.timing: Before the first auth or admin implementation ticket enters In Progress
rules.verification: Record the route-group tree and layout owner for every family, then test declared landmarks and inheritance.
rules.rollback: Remove new route-group wiring and return to the approved storefront-only layout.

rules.timing: When a second independent workspace needs the same stable contract
rules.verification: Name both consumers, dependency direction, compatibility policy and contract tests before promotion.
rules.rollback: Keep or return the contract to its first consumer until two consumers exist.

rules.verification: Use one ticket-scoped branch and one dedicated pull request based on main; record the ticket, branch and pull request links.
rules.rollback: Close the mixed-scope pull request without merging and split the work into ticket-owned branches.

rules.verification: Select Sol, Terra or Luna explicitly with reasoning effort and record a one-line cost/correctness rationale in the Agent Run.
rules.rollback: Stop the delegation and route upward to Sol when scope, security, data integrity or correctness is uncertain.

rules.verification: Use the worker concurrency limit from the root AGENTS.md, start one reviewer only after green CI and stop or reuse every completed worker immediately after handoff.
rules.rollback: Stop excess or idle agents, keep the current PR as the only active vertical scope and resume from its recorded handoff.

rules.timing: After required CI is green and before merge
rules.verification: Record PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED against the exact pull-request head SHA and required check-suite URLs.
rules.rollback: Treat a new head or red required check as non-closing and start a new independent review run.

rules.verification: Preserve the failed review, apply one bounded correction bundle, rerun exact-head CI and create a new review run.
rules.rollback: Revert only the correction bundle or keep the ticket In Progress; never rewrite the failed result as PASS.

rules.verification: Run one table-driven vector set through API and web parsers and require equal valid, invalid, default and canonical classifications.
rules.rollback: Revert the grammar change or restore the last generated client and URL contract; do not add a second runtime contract package for a hypothetical change.

rules.timing: Whenever cached catalog data or private user data is introduced or changed
rules.verification: Keep public catalog cache keys query-specific and failure-free; require private auth, cart and order responses to stay private and no-store.
rules.rollback: Disable the affected cache path, preserve the authoritative backend result and rerun connected, unavailable and privacy checks.

rules.owner: Catalog data or asset owner and independent reviewer
rules.timing: Whenever catalog seed content, slugs, image paths or production asset bytes change
rules.verification: Require deterministic fixture identity plus exact slug, local path, checksum and reviewer-owned provenance coverage.
rules.rollback: Restore the last accepted fixture and asset manifest together; keep the ignored reference bundle local and outside Git and Docker contexts.

cleanOrder: pnpm exec turbo run lint test:unit build --force
